sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gablach was a giant woman of Irish legend. A huge man named Lutur came from Spain to court her. When her family met Lutur, an army surrounded them. The human hero Fuither also wanted Gablach's hand and demanded battle. Lutur seized a roofbeam and struck down many soldiers. The fight roused Gablach. She joined the battle and killed Fuither in defense of her fiancé.

okr.objective: Set down the legend of the giantess Gablach and the battle for her hand.
key_results: Introduce Gablach as a giant woman courted by the Spanish giant Lutur.
Describe Fuither's demand for battle and his attack.
Relate Gablach's armed defense of her fiancé and the death of Fuither.
